arguments.text: Manchester City arrive as clear favourites at this fixture, with the model making the away win 49% probable compared to a league baseline of 28%. Leeds face a significant task against a side whose expected goals output of 2.02 substantially exceeds the hosts' 1.21, with the most likely scorelines all featuring City victories. The model suggests this will be a relatively open contest with both teams likely to score in 58% of simulations, though City's attacking threat makes them the likely winners.
